_note: What you see: Handling a report without an account: deadlines, a conversation via the report code, and access to the reporter's identity only through the confidential adviser.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: Een melding zonder account behandelen: termijnen, gesprek via de meldcode, en inzage in de melder alleen via de vertrouwenspersoon.
ontvangen 22 sep 2026 · de melder komt t: received 22 Sep 2026 · the reporter returns with a report code
Bij de afdeling inkoop worden opdrachten: The purchasing department keeps awarding green maintenance contracts just below the tender threshold, to the same company. This has been going on since the start of this year.
Wij hebben uw melding ontvangen en gaan: We received your report and will investigate it. Within three months you will hear what we did with it.
Weet u om welke opdrachten het gaat, bij: Do you know which contracts this concerns, for example a period or a neighbourhood?
Vooral het onderhoud van de parken in Oo: Mainly the maintenance of the parks in Oosthaven, in February and May.
Interne notitie, de melder ziet dit niet: Internal note, the reporter does not see this
Facturen februari en mei opgevraagd bij: Requested the February and May invoices from purchasing.
De melder leest dit als hij terugkomt me: The reporter reads this when they return with their report code. They get no email unless they left contact details.
Apart bewaard en afgeschermd. Alleen de: Stored separately and shielded. Only the confidential adviser, M. Kuiper, can access them, on a request with a reason. Every request and every decision is logged.
Waarom moet u weten wie de melder is?: Why do you need to know who the reporter is?
Voor het onderzoek willen wij de melder: For the investigation we want to hear the reporter as a witness.
Zonder reden kan het verzoek niet worden: The request cannot be sent without a reason.
Alleen M. Kuiper ziet hier Toestaan en W: Only M. Kuiper sees Allow and Refuse here. An administrator who is not a confidential adviser cannot access it.
